text: El Santuario is a town and municipality located in the Antioquia Department of Colombia, within the Eastern Antioquia subregion. It was founded on 11 March 1765 by Captain Antonio Gómez de Castro. The town lies at an elevation of 2,150 meters above sea level and has an average temperature of 17 °C. It is situated 57 kilometers from Medellín, the capital of the Antioquia Department, and covers a total area of 83.45 km². El Santuario is notable for being the birthplace of comedian Guillermo Zuluaga, known as "Montecristo," and actor Crisanto Alonso Vargas, known as "Vargasvil." The primary economic activity in the town is agriculture, focusing on the cultivation of vegetables, beans, potatoes, and legumes.
